Conversely, a major technological breakthrough, a significantly better-than-expected earnings season for key companies, or an unanticipated positive economic stimulus package could fuel a stronger-than-projected rally, pushing the value above the upper bound, especially over the longer horizons. These types of low-probability, high-impact events are challenging to quantify but represent the primary threats to the accuracy of even a well-reasoned probabilistic forecast.
